entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Long time no see.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: We met last on Christmas Eve, right?[n]...Mm, never mind. It's nothing.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: I have two great pieces of news for you[n]today.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: First, we finally managed to prosecute[n]Masayoshi Shido. He'll likely be found[n]guilty.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: I'm grateful for your cooperation with[n]the trial. Your testimony proved to be[n]very useful.
I'm glad to hear that.
What a relief.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: To be frank, it seemed almost hopeless[n]at one point.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: But thanks to the civil protests, some of[n]the more indecisive prosecutors came to[n]our side.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: It will likely be some more time until the[n]hearing begins, but this is the first step[n]to true change.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: The only charges right now are for[n]breaking election laws, breaking[n]funding control laws, and bribery.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: I knew that proving the Metaverse's[n]existence would be difficult... but[n]I still find myself dissatisfied.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Shido did admit to all of his crimes though,[n]including everything you know about.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Now for the other piece of good news.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: As of today, you'll be free to go.
I get to leave?
Really?
Why so suddenly?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: That's right.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: That's right.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Shido's confession brought light to the[n]truth of your case.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: We were able to prove your innocence[n]in the original assault charge that led to[n]your arrest.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Your sentence will no doubt be rescinded.[n]You're a free man.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: The others did everything they could[n]for you.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Bringing in the woman who was the victim[n]in your case as a witness was the turning[n]point.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: To think they'd be able to track down[n]someone involved in a case from well[n]over a year ago...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: That wasn't all... An unbelievable amount[n]of support has come in from various[n]other places as well.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Regardless, the righteous Phantom[n]Thieves are gone.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: All that remains is for us adults to lead[n]society in the right direction.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: ...Then again, I have to wonder if you[n]believe what I say.
We made a promise.
I trust you... sort of.
I'm not so sure.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Thank you.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: I suppose I'll have to do my best so that[n]you can believe in me in full someday.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: That's unfortunate, but I suppose it[n]doesn't come as a surprise...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: I will certainly prove it with results though.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Still, I'm glad I was able to save you[n]in court. I've never felt so happy in[n]my entire life.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: I'm not quite sure how to put it, but...[n]saving your future meant more to me[n]than my own career.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: I feel like you even taught me how to live.
You're exaggerating.
That wasn't my intention...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: That's not true.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: ...By the way, there's something that's[n]been on my mind.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: What did the Treasure of my world[n]turn out to be?
I don't remember.
Why do you want to know?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: And that's perfectly fine. This isn't an[n]investigation, after all.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: I suppose it doesn't matter now one way[n]or the other.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: There is... one more thing. I haven't even[n]told Makoto about this...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: But I realized something after meeting[n]all of you.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: My most prized "treasure" is the justice[n]I use to protect those important to me.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Makoto helped show me that as well.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Once the Shido case is settled,[n]I'm thinking of quitting my job[n]and becoming a defense lawyer.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: I wanted to reform the system, but[n]I'll have to leave that to someone else.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Going forward, I want to enact justice[n]not for myself, but for the sake of others.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Well then, I need to go submit[n]the paperwork for your release.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Thank you again for everything you've[n]done.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: See you later.
